from pathlib import Path

trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3158,"var":"z->img_comp[i].h / z->img_comp[i].v","code":"z->img_comp[i].h = (q >> 4);  z->img_comp[i].v = q & 15;","note":"A crafted JPEG SOF header supplies the per-component sampling factors used by the decoder."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3212,"var":"z->img_comp[i].raw_data","code":"z->img_comp[i].raw_data = stbi__malloc_mad2(z->img_comp[i].w2, z->img_comp[i].h2, 15);","note":"Those sampling factors determine component buffer sizes and keep the malformed layout alive until the resampling phase."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3759,"var":"r->hs","code":"r->hs = z->img_h_max / z->img_comp[k].h;","note":"At load time the decoder derives the horizontal upsampling ratio from the header-controlled sampling factors."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3760,"var":"r->vs","code":"r->vs = z->img_v_max / z->img_comp[k].v;","note":"The vertical upsampling ratio is computed the same way and can be greater than the supported 1 or 2 values."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3770,"var":"r->resample","code":"else                               r->resample = stbi__resample_row_generic;","note":"Before the fix, unsupported ratios fell through to the generic resampler instead of being rejected."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__resample_row_generic","line":3502,"var":"out[i*hs+j]","code":"for (i=0; i < w; ++i) for (j=0; j < hs; ++j) out[i*hs+j] = in_near[i];","note":"The generic resampler assumes integer expansion factors; with unsupported JPEG ratios it can index and repeat data using an invalid hs value."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('trace_written')
PY
